comment: Allowlist for scripts/rebrand.py, the executable form of docs/product-spec.md §1.4/§1.5. Every entry names the reason it is allowed. Adding one is a policy decision: prefer fixing the token unless it is history/attribution, local data written by releases up to 1.7.2, an on-disk contract with something outside this repo, or an inbound value we match and never emit.

files.CHANGELOG.md: history: past releases describe what shipped, including the upstream headers and wordmarks of their time
files.THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES: attribution: retained upstream material and its licences
files.README.md: attribution: the fork link line names the upstream project
files.AGENTS.md: maintainer instructions: documents the frozen upstream procedure
files.docs/upstream-sync.md: history: records the upstream port model now frozen
files.docs/product-spec.md: policy: §1.5 names the retained spellings it allows
files.docs/releasing.md: release history: records past branding faults
files.crates/codegen/chutes-shell/CHANGELOG.md: history: bundled upstream release notes for this crate
files..github/upstream.json: upstream watcher coordinates (frozen, manual dispatch only)
files..github/workflows/upstream-watch.yml: upstream watcher workflow (frozen, manual dispatch only)
files.SOURCE_REV: generated provenance: records the retained upstream revision
files.scripts/port_assist.py: frozen upstream-port tooling; names the upstream tree it compared
files.scripts/seam_sweep.py: frozen seam checker; docstring names the upstream values it compared
files.scripts/rebrand.py: this guard: contains the forbidden-token pattern and policy prose
files.scripts/rebrand_files.json: this allowlist: names the spellings it allows

prefixes.crates/codegen/chutes-update/: legacy install artefacts: prunes grok-* downloads and parses legacy version-name layouts written by <=1.7.2 installs (spec §1.5)
prefixes.crates/common/chutes-tool-protocol/gener: generated bot-relay clients (Kotlin/Swift) for an external protocol contract; do not hand-edit, regenerate with the protocol codegen (known follow-up)
